svg.aria-label: A self-learning Ethernet switch: when a frame arrives it records the source MAC address and port in its table; it forwards to the known port for the destination, or floods to all ports if the destination is unknown. Entries expire after a while.
svg.title: A self-learning Ethernet switch: when a frame arrives it records the source MAC address and port in its table; it forwards to the known port for the destination, or floods to all ports if the destination is unknown. Entries expire after a while.
svg.text: (learned from source addresses, expire after ~5 min)
Unknown destination? Flood out of every port except the one it came in on.
